LESSON_FIFTEEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.titleEnglish: Compare Things with 跟…(不)一樣
LESSON_FIFTEEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.learnerPromise: Say two people or things are the same or different.
LESSON_FIFTEEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.explanation: Use 跟 between the two things and 一樣 for “the same”. Add 不 before 一樣 for “different”. A describing word can follow 一樣.

teachingGlossary.meaning: ending word: something is done or has changed
link word that connects a describing word to a thing
to have a holiday or vacation

LESSON_FIFTEEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.pattern: A + 跟 + B + (不)一樣 (+ Describing word)

items.question: Can I compare two things with 一樣 without 跟?
items.answer: No. When you mention the second item, use 跟 before it: 越南的生肖跟中國的不一樣.
items.wrongTraditional: 越南的生肖中國的不一樣。

right.traditional: 越南的生肖跟中國的不一樣。
right.pinyin: Yuènán de shēngxiào gēn Zhōngguó de bù yíyàng.
right.english: Vietnam’s zodiac is not the same as China’s.
right.simplified: 越南的生肖跟中国的不一样。

items.wrongSimplified: 越南的生肖跟中国的不一样。

items.question: What changes 一樣 to 不一樣?
items.answer: Put 不 before 一樣 for “not the same”: 弟弟跟哥哥不一樣聰明. 弟弟跟哥哥一樣不聰明 means both are not smart — a different meaning.
items.wrongTraditional: 弟弟跟哥哥一樣不聰明。

right.traditional: 弟弟跟哥哥不一樣聰明。
right.pinyin: Dìdi gēn gēge bù yíyàng cōngmíng.
right.english: The younger brother is not as smart as the older brother.
right.simplified: 弟弟跟哥哥不一样聪明。

items.wrongSimplified: 弟弟跟哥哥不一样聪明。

items.question: Where does 得 go in the B pattern?
items.answer: Either side can carry 得, but only one: 他唱歌唱得跟哥哥一樣好 or 他唱歌跟哥哥唱得一樣好. Do not put 得 after both.
items.wrongTraditional: 他唱歌唱得跟哥哥唱得一樣好。

right.traditional: 他唱歌唱得跟哥哥一樣好。
right.pinyin: Tā chànggē chàng de gēn gēge yíyàng hǎo.
right.english: He sings as well as his older brother.
right.simplified: 他唱歌唱得跟哥哥一样好。

items.wrongSimplified: 他唱歌唱得跟哥哥一样好。

text.traditional: 這種藥跟那種藥一樣嗎？
text.simplified: 这种药跟那种药一样吗？
text.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào gēn nà zhǒng yào yíyàng ma?
text.english: Is this medicine the same as that medicine?

text.traditional: 這件事情跟那件事情一樣重要。
text.simplified: 这件事情跟那件事情一样重要。
text.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqíng gēn nà jiàn shìqíng yíyàng zhòngyào.
text.english: This matter is as important as that matter.

text.traditional: 這棟大樓的電梯跟那棟大樓的（電梯）不一樣大。
text.simplified: 这栋大楼的电梯跟那栋大楼的（电梯）不一样大。
text.pinyin: Zhè dòng dàlóu de diàntī gēn nà dòng dàlóu de (diàntī) bù yíyàng dà.
text.english: The elevator in this building is not the same size as the one in that building.

text.traditional: 他打球，跟哥哥打得一樣好。
text.simplified: 他打球，跟哥哥打得一样好。
text.pinyin: Tā dǎqiú, gēn gēge dǎ de yíyàng hǎo.
text.english: He plays ball as well as his older brother.

text.traditional: 姐姐做飯，做得跟媽媽一樣好吃。
text.simplified: 姐姐做饭，做得跟妈妈一样好吃。
text.pinyin: Jiějie zuòfàn, zuò de gēn māma yíyàng hǎochī.
text.english: Older sister cooks as well as Mom.

text.traditional: 那個美國學生寫字，跟中國人寫得一樣好看。
text.simplified: 那个美国学生写字，跟中国人写得一样好看。
text.pinyin: Nàge Měiguó xuésheng xiězì, gēn Zhōngguó rén xiě de yíyàng hǎokàn.
text.english: That American student writes as beautifully as a Chinese person.

subsections.title: A. Two things or people
subsections.explanation: Put 跟 between the two things. Use 一樣 for “the same” and 不一樣 for “different”.

patternRows.english: My cell phone is the same as yours.
Are the Vietnamese zodiac animals different from the Chinese ones?
The younger brother is as clever as his elder brother is.

subsections.title: B. Comparing how an action is done
subsections.explanation: With 得, the describing word can follow 一樣. Either 得 clause can carry 得; the other is left empty.

patternRows.english: He sings as well as you do.

LESSON_FIFTEEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.titleEnglish: Describe an Ongoing State with 著
LESSON_FIFTEEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.learnerPromise: Describe a continuing state or a posture.
LESSON_FIFTEEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.explanation: Put 著 directly after a verb to show that the action or state continues: 她看著窗戶外面. The object follows 著.

teachingGlossary.meaning: ending word: something is done or has changed
link word that connects a describing word to a thing
to have a holiday or vacation

items.question: Where does 著 go?
items.answer: Directly after the verb, before the object: 她看著窗戶外面. Do not put it after the object.

right.english: She is looking outside the window.

items.question: Does 著 mean the action is finished?
items.answer: No. 著 shows a continuing state; 了 shows a completed action. 她看著窗外 is ongoing; 她看了窗外 is completed.

right.english: She is looking outside the window.

items.question: Can an object follow 著?
items.answer: Yes. Put the object after 著: 他拿著燈籠. 著 stays attached to the verb.

text.traditional: 他看著窗戶外面，想著他的女朋友。
text.simplified: 他看着窗户外面，想着他的女朋友。
text.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe chuānghu wàimiàn, xiǎng zhe tā de nǚpéngyǒu.
text.english: He is looking outside the window, thinking of his girlfriend.

text.traditional: 他在門口等著你，你快去找他吧。
text.simplified: 他在门口等着你，你快去找他吧。
text.pinyin: Tā zài ménkǒu děng zhe nǐ, nǐ kuài qù zhǎo tā ba.
text.english: He is waiting for you at the door; go find him quickly.

text.traditional: 很多人在那裡唱著歌、跳著舞，大家都很開心。
text.simplified: 很多人在那里唱着歌、跳着舞，大家都很开心。
text.pinyin: Hěn duō rén zài nàlǐ chàng zhe gē, tiào zhe wǔ, dàjiā dōu hěn kāixīn.
text.english: Many people are singing and dancing there; everyone is happy.

text.traditional: 大家聽著，明天一定要準時到。
text.simplified: 大家听着，明天一定要准时到。
text.pinyin: Dàjiā tīng zhe, míngtiān yídìng yào zhǔnshí dào.
text.english: Everyone listen; tomorrow you must arrive on time.

text.traditional: 你看著我，剛才你說的是真的嗎？
text.simplified: 你看着我，刚才你说的是真的吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ kàn zhe wǒ, gāngcái nǐ shuō de shì zhēn de ma?
text.english: Look at me; is what you just said true?

text.traditional: 你在這裡等著，他們馬上就來了。
text.simplified: 你在这里等着，他们马上就来了。
text.pinyin: Nǐ zài zhèlǐ děng zhe, tāmen mǎshàng jiù lái le.
text.english: Wait here; they are coming right away.

subsections.explanation: Put 著 after the verb. The object follows 著.

patternRows.english: She is looking at the scenery outside the window.

subsections.title: B. A request to keep an action
subsections.explanation: Use V著 to ask someone to keep doing something: 你們看著我.

LESSON_FIFTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.titleEnglish: Express Immediate Sequence with 一……就……
LESSON_FIFTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.learnerPromise: Say that one action happens right after another.
LESSON_FIFTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.explanation: Use 一 before the first action and 就 before the second: 我一看書，就想睡覺. If the subjects are the same, the second subject is often omitted.

teachingGlossary.meaning: ending word: something is done or has changed
link word that connects a describing word to a thing
to have a holiday or vacation

LESSON_FIFTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.pattern: Subject 1 + 一 + Action 1，Subject 2 + 就 + Action 2

patternRows.english: Whenever he has a question, he asks the teacher.
As soon as you said it, I understood it.

items.question: Does the pattern need both 一 and 就?
items.answer: For the “as soon as” meaning, use both: 上網一查就知道了. Without 一 the sentence can still be grammatical, but it loses the immediate-sequence meaning.

right.pinyin: Shàngwǎng yì chá jiù zhīdào le.
right.english: As soon as you look it up online, you will know.

items.question: Where does 就 go when the second subject is named?
items.answer: After the second subject: 我一說話，他就不高興. Do not put 就 before 他.

right.pinyin: Wǒ yì shuōhuà, tā jiù bù gāoxìng.
right.english: As soon as I speak, he is unhappy.

text.traditional: 我一看書，就想睡覺。
text.simplified: 我一看书，就想睡觉。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yí kànshū, jiù xiǎng shuìjiào.
text.english: As soon as I read, I feel sleepy.

text.traditional: 媽媽一知道我發燒了，就開始擔心。
text.simplified: 妈妈一知道我发烧了，就开始担心。
text.pinyin: Māma yì zhīdào wǒ fāshāo le, jiù kāishǐ dānxīn.
text.english: As soon as Mom knew I had a fever, she began to worry.

text.traditional: 他今天很奇怪，我一說話，他就不高興。
text.simplified: 他今天很奇怪，我一说话，他就不高兴。
text.pinyin: Tā jīntiān hěn qíguài, wǒ yì shuōhuà, tā jiù bù gāoxìng.
text.english: He is strange today; as soon as I speak, he is unhappy.

dialogue.title: 十二生肖 · The Chinese Animal Zodiac

text.traditional: 我們下個星期要學第十五課，我剛才先看了一點，書上有很多種動物，我覺得很有意思。
text.simplified: 我们下个星期要学第十五课，我刚才先看了一点，书上有很多种动物，我觉得很有意思。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge xīngqí yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, wǒ gāngcái xiān kàn le yìdiǎn, shū shàng yǒu hěn duō zhǒng dòngwù, wǒ juéde hěn yǒuyìsi.
text.english: We are going to study Lesson 15 next week. I just glanced at it earlier. There are many kinds of animals in the book, which I think is very interesting.

text.traditional: 有哪些動物？
text.simplified: 有哪些动物？
text.pinyin: Yǒu nǎxiē dòngwù?
text.english: What animals are there?

text.traditional: 我記得有羊、馬、兔子，最特別的是龍。你看看！
text.simplified: 我记得有羊、马、兔子，最特别的是龙。你看看！
text.pinyin: Wǒ jìdé yǒu yáng, mǎ, tùzi, zuì tèbié de shì lóng. Nǐ kànkan!
text.english: I remember there are goats, horses, rabbits, and the most special one is the dragon. Take a look!

text.traditional: 原來是十二生肖，真的很有意思。
text.simplified: 原来是十二生肖，真的很有意思。
text.pinyin: Yuánlái shì shí'èr shēngxiào, zhēn de hěn yǒuyìsi.
text.english: Oh, so it’s the Chinese zodiac! That’s really fascinating.

text.traditional: 什麼是十二生肖？
text.simplified: 什么是十二生肖？
text.pinyin: Shénme shì shí'èr shēngxiào?
text.english: What is the Chinese zodiac?

text.traditional: 華人用不一樣的動物代表每一年，一共有十二種動物。
text.simplified: 华人用不一样的动物代表每一年，一共有十二种动物。
text.pinyin: Huárén yòng bù yíyàng de dòngwù dàibiǎo měi yì nián, yígòng yǒu shí'èr zhǒng dòngwù.
text.english: Chinese people use different animals to represent each year. There are twelve animals in total.

text.traditional: 越南也有十二生肖，可是我們沒有兔年，有貓年。我是貓年出生的，屬貓。
text.simplified: 越南也有十二生肖，可是我们没有兔年，有猫年。我是猫年出生的，属猫。
text.pinyin: Yuènán yě yǒu shí'èr shēngxiào, kěshì wǒmen méiyǒu tùnián, yǒu māonián. Wǒ shì māonián chūshēng de, shǔ māo.
text.english: Vietnam also has the twelve zodiac animals, but we don't have the Year of the Rabbit; we have the Year of the Cat. I was born in the Year of the Cat, so my zodiac sign is the cat.

text.traditional: 真的？好有趣！原來越南的生肖跟中國的有點不一樣。我好想知道我屬什麼。
text.simplified: 真的？好有趣！原来越南的生肖跟中国的有点不一样。我好想知道我属什么。
text.pinyin: Zhēn de? Hǎo yǒuqù! Yuánlái Yuènán de shēngxiào gēn Zhōngguó de yǒudiǎn bù yíyàng. Wǒ hǎo xiǎng zhīdào wǒ shǔ shénme.
text.english: Really? How interesting! It turns out Vietnam's zodiac is a bit different from China's. I really want to know what sign I am.

text.traditional: 很簡單，上網一查就知道了。
text.simplified: 很简单，上网一查就知道了。
text.pinyin: Hěn jiǎndān, shàngwǎng yì chá jiù zhīdào le.
text.english: It's very simple. Just look it up online and you'll know immediately.

text.traditional: 好，我上網查查看。
text.simplified: 好，我上网查查看。
text.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ shàngwǎng cháchá kàn.
text.english: Okay, I'll search for it online.

comprehension.prompt: 越南的生肖有什麼特別的地方？
comprehension.hint: Listen to Yuanzhen talk about Vietnam's zodiac.

LESSON_FIFTEEN_PART_TWO.title: Grammar 2 · Describe Ongoing States with 著

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Describe an Ongoing State with 著
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe a continuing state or a posture.
grammarPages.explanation: Put 著 directly after a verb to show that the action or state continues: 她看著窗戶外面. The object follows 著.

teachingGlossary.meaning: ending word: something is done or has changed
link word that connects a describing word to a thing
to have a holiday or vacation

items.question: Where does 著 go?
items.answer: Directly after the verb, before the object: 她看著窗戶外面. Do not put it after the object.

right.english: She is looking outside the window.

items.question: Does 著 mean the action is finished?
items.answer: No. 著 shows a continuing state; 了 shows a completed action. 她看著窗外 is ongoing; 她看了窗外 is completed.

right.english: She is looking outside the window.

items.question: Can an object follow 著?
items.answer: Yes. Put the object after 著: 他拿著燈籠. 著 stays attached to the verb.

text.traditional: 他看著窗戶外面，想著他的女朋友。
text.simplified: 他看着窗户外面，想着他的女朋友。
text.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe chuānghu wàimiàn, xiǎng zhe tā de nǚpéngyǒu.
text.english: He is looking outside the window, thinking of his girlfriend.

text.traditional: 他在門口等著你，你快去找他吧。
text.simplified: 他在门口等着你，你快去找他吧。
text.pinyin: Tā zài ménkǒu děng zhe nǐ, nǐ kuài qù zhǎo tā ba.
text.english: He is waiting for you at the door; go find him quickly.

text.traditional: 很多人在那裡唱著歌、跳著舞，大家都很開心。
text.simplified: 很多人在那里唱着歌、跳着舞，大家都很开心。
text.pinyin: Hěn duō rén zài nàlǐ chàng zhe gē, tiào zhe wǔ, dàjiā dōu hěn kāixīn.
text.english: Many people are singing and dancing there; everyone is happy.

text.traditional: 大家聽著，明天一定要準時到。
text.simplified: 大家听着，明天一定要准时到。
text.pinyin: Dàjiā tīng zhe, míngtiān yídìng yào zhǔnshí dào.
text.english: Everyone listen; tomorrow you must arrive on time.

text.traditional: 你看著我，剛才你說的是真的嗎？
text.simplified: 你看着我，刚才你说的是真的吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ kàn zhe wǒ, gāngcái nǐ shuō de shì zhēn de ma?
text.english: Look at me; is what you just said true?

text.traditional: 你在這裡等著，他們馬上就來了。
text.simplified: 你在这里等着，他们马上就来了。
text.pinyin: Nǐ zài zhèlǐ děng zhe, tāmen mǎshàng jiù lái le.
text.english: Wait here; they are coming right away.

subsections.title: A. A continuing action or state
subsections.explanation: Put 著 after the verb. The object follows 著.

patternRows.english: She is looking at the scenery outside the window.

subsections.title: B. A request to keep an action
subsections.explanation: Use V著 to ask someone to keep doing something: 你們看著我.

patternRows.english: Everyone, look at me; do not read your book.

dialogue.title: 十二生肖 · The Chinese Animal Zodiac

text.traditional: 中明，你手裡拿著什麼？
text.simplified: 中明，你手里拿着什么？
text.pinyin: Zhōngmíng, nǐ shǒulǐ názhe shénme?
text.english: Zhongming, what are you holding in your hand?

text.traditional: 這是燈籠。
text.simplified: 这是灯笼。
text.pinyin: Zhè shì dēnglóng.
text.english: This is a lantern.

text.traditional: 燈籠上的小老虎好可愛。
text.simplified: 灯笼上的小老虎好可爱。
text.pinyin: Dēnglóng shàng de xiǎo lǎohǔ hǎo kě'ài.
text.english: The little tiger on the lantern is so cute.

text.traditional: 這是我朋友做的，因為他屬虎。你知道十二生肖嗎？
text.simplified: 这是我朋友做的，因为他属虎。你知道十二生肖吗？
text.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ péngyǒu zuò de, yīnwèi tā shǔ hǔ. Nǐ zhīdào shí'èr shēngxiào ma?
text.english: A friend of mine made it because he was born in the year of the tiger. Do you know about the twelve zodiac animals?

text.traditional: 知道，友美跟我講過。
text.simplified: 知道，友美跟我讲过。
text.pinyin: Zhīdào, Yǒuměi gēn wǒ jiǎng guò.
text.english: Yes, Youmei mentioned it to me.

text.traditional: 這個星期六是元宵節，你跟友美會去看燈會嗎？
text.simplified: 这个星期六是元宵节，你跟友美会去看灯会吗？
text.pinyin: Zhège xīngqíliù shì Yuánxiāojié, nǐ gēn Yǒuměi huì qù kàn dēnghuì ma?
text.english: This Saturday is the Lantern Festival. Are you and Youmei going to see the lantern show?

text.traditional: 友美說她想去，我還沒決定去不去。燈會好玩嗎？
text.simplified: 友美说她想去，我还没决定去不去。灯会好玩吗？
text.pinyin: Yǒuměi shuō tā xiǎng qù, wǒ hái méi juédìng qù bú qù. Dēnghuì hǎowán ma?
text.english: Youmei said she wants to go, but I haven't decided yet. Is the lantern festival fun?

text.traditional: 我去年去看了，很多大人帶著小孩去看燈會，非常熱鬧。我照了很多相片。
text.simplified: 我去年去看了，很多大人带着小孩去看灯会，非常热闹。我照了很多相片。
text.pinyin: Wǒ qùnián qù kàn le, hěn duō dàrén dàizhe xiǎohái qù kàn dēnghuì, fēicháng rènào. Wǒ zhào le hěn duō xiàngpiàn.
text.english: I went last year. Many adults brought their kids to see the lantern show; it was very lively. I took a lot of pictures.

text.traditional: 那我這個週末一定要去看看。
text.simplified: 那我这个周末一定要去看看。
text.pinyin: Nà wǒ zhège zhōumò yídìng yào qù kànkan.
text.english: Then I must definitely go see it this weekend.

text.traditional: 我週末還要工作，打算一下班就去看燈會。我們可以約友美一起去。
text.simplified: 我周末还要工作，打算一下班就去看灯会。我们可以约友美一起去。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò hái yào gōngzuò, dǎsuàn yí xiàbān jiù qù kàn dēnghuì. Wǒmen kěyǐ yuē Yǒuměi yìqǐ qù.
text.english: I have to work this weekend, but I plan to go see the lantern show right after getting off work. We can invite Youmei to join us.

comprehension.hint: Yiwen asks Zhongming what is in his hand.

LESSON_FIFTEEN_PART_THREE.title: Grammar 3 · Immediate Sequence with 一……就……

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Express Immediate Sequence with 一……就……
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that one action happens right after another.
grammarPages.explanation: Use 一 before the first action and 就 before the second: 我一看書，就想睡覺. If the subjects are the same, the second subject is often omitted.

teachingGlossary.meaning: ending word: something is done or has changed
link word that connects a describing word to a thing
to have a holiday or vacation

grammarPages.pattern: Subject 1 + 一 + Action 1，Subject 2 + 就 + Action 2

patternRows.english: Whenever he has a question, he asks the teacher.
As soon as you said it, I understood it.

items.question: Does the pattern need both 一 and 就?
items.answer: For the “as soon as” meaning, use both: 上網一查就知道了. Without 一 the sentence can still be grammatical, but it loses the immediate-sequence meaning.

right.pinyin: Shàngwǎng yì chá jiù zhīdào le.
right.english: As soon as you look it up online, you will know.

items.question: Where does 就 go when the second subject is named?
items.answer: After the second subject: 我一說話，他就不高興. Do not put 就 before 他.

right.pinyin: Wǒ yì shuōhuà, tā jiù bù gāoxìng.
right.english: As soon as I speak, he is unhappy.

text.traditional: 我一看書，就想睡覺。
text.simplified: 我一看书，就想睡觉。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yí kànshū, jiù xiǎng shuìjiào.
text.english: As soon as I read, I feel sleepy.

text.traditional: 媽媽一知道我發燒了，就開始擔心。
text.simplified: 妈妈一知道我发烧了，就开始担心。
text.pinyin: Māma yì zhīdào wǒ fāshāo le, jiù kāishǐ dānxīn.
text.english: As soon as Mom knew I had a fever, she began to worry.

text.traditional: 他今天很奇怪，我一說話，他就不高興。
text.simplified: 他今天很奇怪，我一说话，他就不高兴。
text.pinyin: Tā jīntiān hěn qíguài, wǒ yì shuōhuà, tā jiù bù gāoxìng.
text.english: He is strange today; as soon as I speak, he is unhappy.

dialogue.title: 有趣的十二生肖 · The Interesting Zodiac

text.traditional: 今天一進教室，就看到桌上放著幾隻用紙做的動物，黑板上也有很多張動物的圖片，我覺得很有趣。
text.simplified: 今天一进教室，就看到桌上放着几只用纸做的动物，黑板上也有很多张动物的图片，我觉得很有趣。
text.pinyin: Jīntiān yí jìn jiàoshì, jiù kàndào zhuō shàng fàngzhe jǐ zhī yòng zhǐ zuò de dòngwù, hēibǎn shàng yě yǒu hěn duō zhāng dòngwù de túpiàn, wǒ juéde hěn yǒuqù.
text.english: As soon as I walked into the classroom today, I saw several paper animals placed on the table, and there were also many pictures of animals on the blackboard. I found it very interesting.

text.traditional: 老師告訴我們，很久以前，有十二種動物一起參加了一個過河比賽，看誰游得最快。
text.simplified: 老师告诉我们，很久以前，有十二种动物一起参加了一个过河比赛，看谁游得最快。
text.pinyin: Lǎoshī gàosu wǒmen, hěn jiǔ yǐqián, yǒu shí'èr zhǒng dòngwù yìqǐ cānjiā le yí ge guòhé bǐsài, kàn shéi yóu de zuì kuài.
text.english: The teacher told us that a long time ago, twelve animals entered a river-crossing race together to see who could swim the fastest.

text.traditional: 開始比賽以後，每隻動物都游得很快很辛苦。老鼠先過了河，第二個到的是牛，最後到的是豬。老鼠贏了，排第一，其他動物排後面。
text.simplified: 开始比赛以后，每只动物都游得很快很辛苦。老鼠先过了河，第二个到的是牛，最后到的是猪。老鼠赢了，排第一，其他动物排后面。
text.pinyin: Kāishǐ bǐsài yǐhòu, měi zhī dòngwù dōu yóu de hěn kuài hěn xīnkǔ. Lǎoshǔ xiān guò le hé, dì èr ge dào de shì niú, zuìhòu dào de shì zhū. Lǎoshǔ yíng le, pái dì yī, qítā dòngwù pái hòumiàn.
text.english: After the race began, each animal swam hard and fast. The rat crossed the river first, the ox arrived second, and the pig arrived last. The rat won, ranking first, and the other animals lined up behind.

text.traditional: 這次比賽以後，華人就用鼠、牛、虎、兔、龍、蛇、馬、羊、猴、雞、狗和豬代表每一年，而且叫這十二種動物「十二生肖」。
text.simplified: 这次比赛以后，华人就用鼠、牛、虎、兔、龙、蛇、马、羊、猴、鸡、狗和猪代表每一年，而且叫这十二种动物「十二生肖」。
text.pinyin: Zhè cì bǐsài yǐhòu, Huárén jiù yòng shǔ, niú, hǔ, tù, lóng, shé, mǎ, yáng, hóu, jī, gǒu hé zhū dàibiǎo měi yì nián, érqiě jiào zhè shí'èr zhǒng dòngwù "shí'èr shēngxiào".
text.english: After this race, Chinese people used the rat, ox, tiger, rabbit, dragon, snake, horse, goat, monkey, rooster, dog, and pig to represent each year, calling these twelve animals the "Twelve Zodiac Animals".

text.traditional: 華人聊天的時候，會問別人「你屬什麼？」。每年到了元宵節，代表那年的動物燈籠，也會最受歡迎。
text.simplified: 华人聊天的时候，会问别人「你属什么？」。每年到了元宵节，代表那年的动物灯笼，也会最受欢迎。
text.pinyin: Huárén liáotiān de shíhòu, huì wèn biérén "nǐ shǔ shénme?". Měi nián dào le Yuánxiāojié, dàibiǎo nà nián de dòngwù dēnglóng, yě huì zuì shòu huānyíng.
text.english: When chatting, Chinese people often ask others, "What is your zodiac sign?". Every year during the Lantern Festival, the lantern representing the animal of that year is also the most popular.
